children: U.S. GoldMining completed a 7,493-meter, 17-hole 2026 drill program at its 100% owned Whistler Gold-Copper Project and anticipates assay results in coming weeks.
Completed a record 7,493 meters across 17 core holes testing 10 targets in the Whistler Orbit—largest program since company inception.
Drilling targeted district-scale porphyry centers across the 53,700-acre property to expand known Whistler, Raintree and Island Mountain systems.
Project hosts estimated 5.41 Moz AuEq indicated and 4.97 Moz AuEq inferred across key deposits used in the March 2026 PEA.
March 2026 PEA modeled after-tax NPV5% of US$2.04B and IRR of 33.0% using only indicated resources from the Whistler deposit.
On-site core logging and sampling underway; initial assay results expected in the coming weeks through end of 2026, pending lab turnaround.
